title: Auntie Ethel's Hair
summary: Consume the chosen variant for a permanent +1 to its ability score.

fields.Effect: Choose Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma when receiving the reward. Consuming the hair increases that score permanently by 1.
fields.Limits: The bonus does not change a score currently set to a fixed value by gear or an elixir.
fields.Acquisition: Reward from Auntie Ethel’s bargain in the Overgrown Tunnel.
fields.Base value: 280 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 mechanics and pinned item and related rule sources.
